privateKey.notes: our own keypair; the app's embedded server public key was replaced with the matching public half, so the wrapped CEK can be unwrapped locally

verified.how: CEK unwrapped with the swapped private key; A256CTR content decrypted to the login JSON

key.notes: responses are encrypted with the same per-message CEK; frida-run.py keeps /tmp/cek.hex current

notes: alg=RSA-OAEP, enc=A256CTR — non-standard content mode, so the JWE tag segment is empty and is reused verbatim on re-encrypt.
Patch proxy is required: the client encrypts to the real server key, so in-flight decrypt+re-encrypt is the only way to see and edit live traffic.
The public key is fetched per session from GET /critico/keys — re-run the swap after every re-login.
